messages:
Priya Singh: Quick flag 1: partner (Nimbus Systems) wants to list a private offer and let customers activate immediately. ops/finance/legal need to sign off on billing/credits before marketplace listing.
Ethan Moore: what's the ask? are they pushing pricing that differs from our standard SKUs?
Priya Singh: yes 1: committed-spend bucket with stepped discount + an early-conversion credit if a pre-list customer migrates to the marketplace SKU within 90 days.
Liang Zhao: technical note 1: marketplace needs stable SKU IDs. Nimbus wants to reuse a custom SKU that maps to our metered SKU. we need mapping table and deprecation cadence.
Sam (Legal): redlines to consider: explicit renewal schedule, audit rights for usage-based discounts, and a max credit liability. also need a clause preventing public disclosure of private pricing until listing goes live.
Nina (Finance): +1 on cap. propose credit cap = lesser of $100k or 15% of ARR for the customer. also need to decide revenue recognition: are conversion credits contra-revenue or billed as separate line items? accounting prefers contra-revenue.
Ethan Moore: ops question 1: if a customer signs pre-list, do we allow activation now or only after marketplace acceptance?
Priya Singh: partner wants activation now to reduce friction. brightline: activation allowed if contract signed and finance issues a pre-list invoice token. marketing must not publicize.
MKTG-Bot: FYI checklist created: marketplace-listing-checklist/1779123456. Reminder: no public assets until listing date. :warning:
Sam (Legal): sample discount schedule we typically want in private offers:
```
- Year1: 25% off list for committed units
- Year2: 15% off (auto-step unless renegotiated)
- Year3: 10% off
- Early-conversion credit: $X one-time, capped and applied as contra-revenue
```
Liang Zhao: SI ask 1: 60-day SKU deprecation notice for any mapping changes that affect partner offers. add as appendix.
Nina (Finance): also need to factor marketplace take (e.g., 5-10%) into net ARR impact. credits reduce recognized revenue. Ill run a quick model.
Ethan Moore: ops constraint: marketplace enforces price per unit. if partner's private offer has tiered consumption discounts, we need to pin the tiers in the private offer metadata.
Priya Singh: decision proposal:
- allow pre-list activation for signed customers
- require capped conversion credit (finance to set cap)
- include SKU mapping appendix + 60-day deprecation notice
- insert explicit renewal step-down schedule in private offer T&Cs
- marketing embargo until marketplace soft-list date
Sam (Legal): ok I can draft the T&Cs + appendix. need final cap number from finance.
Nina (Finance): I'll share a model by EOD with recommended cap and GL treatment.
MKTG-Bot: scheduled reminder: review meeting tomorrow 10am PT (thread 1779130000). :bell:
Priya Singh: thanks all 1: action items: Sam draft T&Cs, Nina model cap, Liang produce SKU mapping CSV, Ethan coordinate ops gating. reconvene 10am PT. :calendar:
